name: vstack
tagline_zh: 把散落各处的技能、代理和钩子叠成一摞，跨平台即插即用。还附赠一个 Pi，像开盲盒多送颗糖。
tagline_en: Stack skills, agents, hooks across harnesses—plug and play. Bonus: a side of Pi, like a free candy in your toolbox.
desc_en: Skills, agents, hooks. Cross-harness. With a side of Pi.
why_zh: 同类工具只管单机，它却把跨框架的碎片拼成一套，还白送个 Pi 彩蛋，省去你到处找胶水。
why_en: Unlike single-harness tools, it stitches cross-platform fragments into one stack—plus a Pi easter egg, no glue needed.
